notes: needs ruling: the cited treatise's author (Saʿd b. Hibat Allah al-Rawandi) is named before the chain; the Muʿjam is quoting him, and the Muʿjam's own compiler is not a transmitter (rule 11)
«أبيهما» is a bare relation: the father was named earlier as «علي بن عبد الصمد» but is not merged with him (rule 9)
«عليه السلام» and the title and «[-/4]» numbering are left out; the Imam after «عن» stays a narrator
